versions.changelog:
Initial release of ephemeral-eng: a self-contained framework for building input-to-deliverable engineering calculators as single-file HTML tools.

- Provides a standardized five-slot template: brand tokens, input schema, calculation engine, live diagram, and report pages.
- Enforces strict rules for verification, code value entry, and scope limitation to ensure only hand-verifiable, safe engineering checks.
- Mandates portable project state via input JSON save/load, including clear source attribution for AI-generated data.
- Standardizes paginated, print-ready reporting—including input auditing, substituted calculation steps, and branded deliverable formatting.
- Details conventions for inputs, units, code references, and editing workflow to maintain safety and consistency across all generated tools.
